uz: AMG'ning eng kuchli GT gibrid kupelaridan biri.
Old qism: agressiv AMG Panamericana uslubi.
Keng kuzov va past sport silueti.
Orqa dizayn: faol aerodinamika va kuchli stance.
Premium kokpit va AMG Performance boshqaruvlari.
4.0L V8 biturbo + elektr motor.
Tizim quvvati: 600 kW / 816 PS.
Maksimal moment: 1,420 Nm.
0–100 km/soat: 2.8 soniya.
Maksimal tezlik: 320 km/soat.
AMG Performance 4MATIC+ va 9 pog'onali MCT.
Supercar tezligi + grand-tourer komforti.
ru: Один из самых мощных гибридных купе AMG GT.
Широкий кузов и низкий спортивный силуэт.
Задняя часть: активная аэродинамика и мощная посадка.
Премиальный кокпит и органы управления AMG Performance.
en: One of AMG GT's most powerful hybrid coupes.
Front end: aggressive AMG performance styling.
Wide body with a low sports-car silhouette.
Rear: active aero and a powerful stance.
Premium cockpit with AMG Performance controls.

uz: Yettinchi avlod M5 — ilk bor M HYBRID tizimida.
Katta kidney panjarasi va agressiv M grafika.
Kengaytirilgan kuzov va mushakdor yon profil.
Diffuzor va to'rt chiqishli M exhaust dizayni.
M kokpit: sport, texnologiya va kundalik qulaylik.
4.4L V8 TwinPower Turbo + elektr motor.
Umumiy quvvat: 535 kW / 727 PS.
Tizim momenti: 1,000 Nm.
0–100 km/soat: 3.5 soniya.
Maksimal tezlik: 305 km/soatgacha.
M xDrive va 8 pog'onali M Steptronic.
Biznes sedan ko'rinishidagi yuqori unumli gibrid.
ru: Седьмое поколение M5 — впервые с системой M HYBRID.
M-кокпит: спорт, технологии и повседневный комфорт.
en: The seventh-generation M5 introduces M HYBRID power.
Large kidney grille with aggressive M graphics.
Wider body and a muscular side profile.
Rear diffuser with four M exhaust outlets.
M cockpit blends performance, tech and daily comfort.
A high-performance hybrid disguised as a business sedan.
